extraction.Name: Emma Coryell

extraction.Buyer: Lots 1 & 2 & Si of NE deeded to Frank B. Smith, Gordon, Nebr. by Emma Coryell and Earl Coryell, Husband and wife, for $1100.00. Recorded Sep. 20, 1918.
extraction.NOTES: Receipt dated Jul. 1, 1918. Agreement for Warranty Deed to Frank B.
